content.short: STON.fi is the primary AMM DEX on the TON blockchain, featuring deep Telegram integration and gas-free trading.
content.description:
STON.fi is the definitive decentralized exchange and automated market maker (AMM) built natively on The Open Network (TON). Designed for maximum accessibility, the platform is deeply integrated with the Telegram ecosystem, allowing users to execute trades and manage liquidity directly through a familiar messaging interface. STON.fi features a unique "gasless" trading experience, where transaction fees are automatically deducted from the assets being swapped, eliminating the need for users to hold native TON tokens for every interaction.

Utilizing advanced cross-chain technology based on Hashed Timelock Contracts (HTLC), STON.fi provides a secure and transparent venue for asset exchange without centralized intermediaries. The protocol is powered by the $STON token, which facilitates governance and incentive coordination within the community. As a cornerstone of the TON DeFi landscape, STON.fi is dedicated to providing the essential financial tools needed for participants to explore and expand the decentralized economy within the world's most popular social messaging platform.
